name: Light Net
description: Cast a light net of soul force wide and feel where it dips under a moving soul.

name: Folded Mesh
description: Throw a folded mesh of soul force that opens round a target as it lands.

name: Mesh Thorn
description: Stab a thorn of soul force through the mesh into the soul it holds.

name: Cinching Weave
description: Cinch the weave round a group so every soul in it feels its force draw thin.

name: Net Swing
description: Swing the body on a net line of soul force to a point behind a foe.

name: Plaited Guard
description: Weave a guard of soul force round the self that bends hostile mental pushes aside.

name: Casting Net
description: Cast a net of soul force over open air that falls on the first soul to enter it.

name: Mesh Taint
description: Leave a taint of soul force in the mesh that dulls the focus of every soul caught in it.

name: Weighted Net
description: Weigh a vast net of soul force with held pressure so every soul inside it sinks and slows.

name: Skyfall Net
description: Let a net of soul force as wide as the sky fall over all souls in range and draw tight on each.

name: High Reading
description: Hold soul force high above the body and read the souls beneath it as shifts in its weight.

name: Stoop Cinch
description: Drop a cinch of soul force on a target from the full height of the user's reach.

name: Falling Thorn
description: Let a thorn of soul force fall from overhead into the soul of a target below.

name: Plummet Weft
description: Plummet a weft of soul force onto a target so it is pinned beneath at once.

name: Pinion Canopy
description: Hold a pinion of soul force over the self to turn aside falling mental blows.

name: Climbing Step
description: Climb a rising thread of soul force to reach a height above a foe.

name: Gathered Plunge
description: Gather soul force high and plunge it through a target's guard in a single line.

name: Long Fall
description: Hang a snare of soul force high in open air that falls the whole way onto the soul that passes below.

name: Stooping Barbs
description: Rain barbs of soul force that cling to the souls beneath and gnaw at their focus.

name: Raptor Plunge
description: Dive from a great height of soul force through every guard and strike the core of a target in one fall.

name: Apex Stoop
description: Gather soul force for a long breath above a wide span and drop it as one crushing snare on every soul beneath.

name: Anchor Hearing
description: Listen through the Core for the faintest stir of any soul within the whole span of the cage.

name: Gaoler Cinch
description: Close a cinch of Core-fed soul force on a target's limb to halt it.

name: Anchor Barb
description: Drive a barb fed by the soul anchor into a soul within reach.

name: Planted Seed
description: Plant a seed of soul force directly in a target's soul-space that dulls the next technique it gathers.

name: Sunk Shackle
description: Sink a shackle of soul force into a target's soul so it moves as if weighted.

name: Moored Guard
description: Hold the soul fast to the Core so hostile soul force finds no purchase.

name: Seeded Soul
description: Plant a snare directly inside a soul within reach that springs when the target next draws on its force.

name: Inner Gin
description: Leave a barbed taint inside a target's soul that sours the force it draws.

name: Stilling Lattice
description: Build a cage of soul force inside a target's own soul-space that holds its techniques from rising.

name: Gaoler's Apex
description: Close an immense Core-fed cage of soul force round a span that no soul inside can leave until the user ends it.

name: Gin Hearing
description: Listen for the faint creak of a gin of soul force as a soul nears its jaws.

name: Jawset Hitch
description: Set the jaws of a small gin of soul force round a target's limb.

name: Windtooth Barb
description: Bite a barb of soul force into the soul of a target brushing the gin.

name: Draught Cover
description: Fan a draught of soul force across a strike to push it from its line.

name: Spring-Set Gin
description: Set a springing gin of soul force that closes on a soul with the first breath of contact.

name: Biting Draught
description: Loose a draught of toothed soul force across a group so each soul takes a bite.

name: Tooth-Sworn Guard
description: Bare teeth of soul force round the self so a grasping soul finds only blades.

name: Hasty Release
description: Release a gin at the instant a foe gathers a technique so the technique breaks.

name: Wind Gin
description: Set a gin of soul force that the wind itself carries across open air to close on a soul.

name: Rusting Bite
description: Let the bite of a gin leave a slow rust of soul force that eats at the strength of a caught soul.

name: Jaw Cascade
description: Raise a field of linked gins of soul force that snap shut in a wave across a wide span.

name: Tempest Maw
description: Gather every gin about the user into a single maw of soul force that closes on all souls in range.

name: Taut Listening
description: Hold a cord of soul force taut and hear its hum change as a soul draws near.

name: Held Cinch
description: Hold a cinch of soul force closed on a target without letting it slacken.

name: Straight Barb
description: Send a straight barb of soul force down a taut line without a wobble.

name: Tightening Hold
description: Tighten a hold of soul force by small degrees each time a target moves.

name: Fastened Cord
description: Fix a line of soul force to a mark and travel its length in a single stride.

name: Unslacked Guard
description: Keep a guard of soul force drawn tight so no mental blow finds slack to sink into.

name: Snapping Release
description: Release held tension in a snap so a lash of soul force strikes every soul along the line.

name: Taut Snare
description: Lay a snare of soul force pulled tight that cannot be slipped once a soul has crossed it.

name: Strain Taint
description: Leave a taint in taut soul force that spreads through a soul with each strain it makes.

name: Unflinching Hold
description: Hold a seal of soul force unflinching on a target through every attempt to break it.

name: Held Taut
description: Draw every cord of soul force in range taut at once so each soul among them is bound in place.

name: Zenith Listening
description: Listen from the peak of the soul's reach for any stir in the whole span below.

name: Crest Cinch
description: Close a cinch of Core-fed soul force on a target's limb as it reaches.

name: Core Barb
description: Send a barb fed from the Core along a laid thread into a soul beyond its guard.

name: Implanted Knot
description: Implant a knot of soul force in a target's soul so its techniques bind as they rise.

name: Moored Step
description: Anchor a thread of soul force at the edge of the Core's reach and step along it to a far point.

name: Rooted Bulwark
description: Root a guard of soul force in the Core so mental blows spend themselves against it.

name: Zenith Snare
description: Plant a snare of soul force at the peak of the user's reach that drops on any soul crossing below.

name: Soul Burr
description: Embed burrs of soul force within a target's soul that tear at its force as it draws.

name: Zenith Lattice
description: Spread a lattice of Core-fed soul force over a great span that closes on whatever enters it.

name: Crowning Snare
description: Gather the full reach of the soul into one snare that closes on a chosen soul with no chance of slipping it.
